_schema_note: The loop's durable memory, and A CACHE — never an authority. The board owns intent, the repository owns content, this file owns nothing; reconcile it against both before advancing (see the pre-flight in loop/README.md). Empty skeleton: fill from loop/goal.md on the first run. Item and finding shapes are documented in loop/README.md. `tiers` is a PROJECT-CONFIGURABLE list, not a fixed taxonomy — add or rename tiers to match this project's dependency graph, and keep `current_tier` pointing at one of them. The board POINTER is deliberately not here: it is a project value and lives in project.config.json -> board. Only DERIVED board ids are cached here, in board_cache.
goal: Translate the U.S. Web Design System Figma library into OutSystems ODC faithfully, tier by tier, as theme tokens + block CSS + Web Components, each handed over as a GitHub Task.

board_cache._note: Derived ids only, refreshed on a miss. An id that stops resolving means someone recreated a field, not that the card vanished. The board's owner/number live in project.config.json -> board.

caps.budget_note: raise/lower for library-scale runs; a full library is hundreds of items

items.decision_log: Maker: --color-<leaf> naming, unprefixed, deliberately colliding with 10 OSUI :root names because that IS the re-branding mechanism (149 consumers of var(--color-primary)); ramps preserved non-uniform; accent-cool and info both emitted at #00BDE3, not aliased; no white/black invented. Checker: core depth, 52/52 measured twice by two methods across 2 viewports, cascade provenance verified, framework consequences settled by measuring rendered widgets rather than reading declarations — which is what surfaced FND-001. Round 2 corrected a comment that inferred consumption from naming.

Nine-step size ramp, design step names preserved (3xs..3xl), sparse USWDS scale indices left uninterpolated, px kept as the design states with the rem trade-off declared not taken silently. Round 1 built 42px for 2xl because the REF said 42px; the checker measured glyph ink in the exported render, flagged it as a 5.4% outlier against a k=5.51 fit, and returned BLOCKED rather than FAIL because the defect was in the ref, not the build. get_design_context on the sample node confirmed 40px. Ref re-frozen from per-node text styles; the discredited layer-name sourcing is recorded in spec.md so it is not repeated.

findings.summary: .alert-info 2.24:1 and .alert-success/.btn-success 3.14:1 — OSUI pairs a white foreground with the base colour token. WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3. Built faithfully; remedy belongs in the override/semantic layer or the Alert item.
Font sizes page labels the 2xl row 42px but styles its sample 40px. Built as 40px. Below the high+ gate, so register-only.
#1B1B1B exposed as Base/base-ink from node 287-98 and Base/ink from node 1892-7566.

--font-size-xs collides with OSUI 12px across 26 consumers; zero rendered defect measured. Mapping question for the semantic/overrides layer: OSUI xs is its smallest-text role and 3xs 13px is closer than the 15px that lands there by name.
